notes: FIXED: in co-op, a player who had been revived or respawned could never take damage again. Everyone takes damage now.

DOORS SIMPLIFIED: 4 doors in a chain - MAIN CORRIDOR, NORTH WING, UPGRADE ROOM (the gun upgrader) and UPSTAIRS (the bridge). Every other way between the areas is boarded up, so no door can be walked or jumped around, including the bridge and the balcony rails.
Buying is easier: you can buy a door or a perk from further away and from the side.
PERK ANIMATIONS last longer, and you can sprint while they play.
FIXED floating blood, mould and writing: decals now only go on real floors, walls and ceilings, and never hang over doorways, the atrium or the stairwells.

FOUR SURVIVORS with their own voices: "DOC" REYES, TANYA "TANK" BRIGGS, LEROY "SMOKES" DAWSON and PENNY "SPARKS" HOLLOWAY. Pick yours in the Zombies lobby. They talk at the start, each round, doors, the box, the upgrader, going down, reviving and more - and react to every perk they smoke or eat. In co-op you hear your teammates too. Subtitles on screen; voice lines can be turned off in the lobby.
